description: Getting Started with Claude Code — education module for AIOS reports

module.title: Getting Started with Claude Code
module.outcome: First working automation between two of your tools

sections.title: What is Claude Code?
sections.content: Claude Code is Anthropic's official CLI tool that lets you use AI directly in your terminal. Think of it as having a technical co-worker who can read your files, run commands, connect to your tools, and build things for you — all through natural conversation.
key_points: Can read and write files, run commands
Connects to your tools via MCP (Model Context Protocol)
Learns your business context over time

sections.title: Installing Claude Code
sections.content: Installation takes about 5 minutes. You need Node.js installed, then run a single command.
steps: Install Node.js if not already installed (nodejs.org)
Run: claude to start your first session
Follow the authentication prompts to connect your Anthropic account

sections.title: Your First MCP Connection
sections.content: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is how Claude Code talks to your business tools. Adding an MCP server is like giving Claude Code a key to one of your tools.
steps: Choose your most-used tool that has an MCP server
Run the install command (e.g., claude mcp add hubspot -- npx -y @hubspot/mcp)
Authenticate with the tool when prompted
Ask Claude Code something about your data (e.g., 'Show me my recent deals')

common_first_connections.what_you_can_do: Search, read, and organize your documents
Search messages, post updates, manage channels

sections.title: Your First Automation
sections.content: Once connected, you can ask Claude Code to do things that span your tools. Start simple — combine data from two tools into something useful.
example_automations: Pull my calendar for tomorrow and create a briefing from my CRM data for each meeting
Check my Stripe dashboard and summarize this month's revenue in Slack
Find all overdue invoices and draft follow-up emails
